overall.summary: CMI's disclosure quality is strong across virtually all dimensions reviewed. The company provides detailed, specific, and quantified disclosures on tariff impacts, supply chain risks, geopolitical exposures, cost/margin drivers, pension funding, and capital allocation. The only notable finding is the removal of tariff compliance risk language from the Legal Proceedings section, which appears to have been relocated to Risk Factors rather than eliminated entirely.
